summary: Computes a scale+bias offset (a2 * scale + bias) with an optional randomization step. Reads the enable byte at this+0x56C; when it is zero it calls the randomization helper sub_5881F0(a2) and scales a2 by the double at this+0x578, otherwise uses a2 unscaled. Adds the bias double at this+0x570 and returns the result. Called per-frame by sub_43C250 and SuspensionAndWheelPhysics for stochastic variation of physics parameters.

local_names.this: physics parameter object: enable flag (this+0x56C), bias (this+0x570), scale (this+0x578)
local_names.v2: running value: a2 or a2 * scale depending on the enable flag

operations.description: Read the enable byte at this+0x56C; when it is zero, run the randomization path: call sub_5881F0(a2) then set v2 = a2 * (double at this+0x578); otherwise leave v2 = a2 unscaled.
Add the bias double at this+0x570 to the (possibly scaled) v2 to form the result.
Return the computed double. Called per-frame by sub_43C250 and SuspensionAndWheelPhysics for stochastic variation of physics parameters.

unresolved: The return value of sub_5881F0 is not captured in the decompiled body (a2 is used unchanged after the call), so it is unresolved whether the helper randomizes via side effect or via a return value lost by the decompiler.
Owner identity is unknown: the LEGACY ABI lead 'RandomOffsetCalculator' names the routine, not a class.
